location.climate: Mediterranean climate, mild year-round (10-25°C), sunny most days

required_documents.notes: Official transcripts from all schools attended
Two teacher recommendations from junior/senior year teachers

english_proficiency.waiver_conditions: Native English speaker or 3+ years at English-medium school

academic_programs.curriculum_structure: Ways of Thinking/Ways of Doing requirements + Major requirements + Electives

korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: Korean restaurants in Palo Alto (5 min), H Mart in San Jose (20 min), 99 Ranch Market nearby
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Palo Alto Korean Church (10 min), Korean Presbyterian Church (15 min)

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Entrepreneurs, founders, researchers with published work, athletes, artists with national/international recognition

korean_specific_advice: Stanford loves entrepreneurs - show initiative in starting something new
'Intellectual vitality' is key - demonstrate genuine curiosity across multiple fields
The 'What matters to you and why' essay is critical - be authentic and specific
Show how you'll contribute to Stanford's collaborative, innovative culture
West Coast schools value personality and fit differently than East Coast - be yourself
International perspective valued - use Korean background as an asset
Demonstrate impact, not just participation - what changed because of you?
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Essays too similar to MIT/Harvard applications - not showing 'Why Stanford'
Overemphasis on achievements without showing personality and curiosity
Not demonstrating entrepreneurial mindset or initiative
'What matters to you' essay too abstract or philosophical without personal connection
Failing to show how Korean background shapes unique perspective
Not showing 'fit' with Stanford's casual, collaborative culture

campus_life.dining_options: 8 dining halls with diverse options, late-night dining, student-run cafes
campus_life.safety_rating: High - Campus security, well-lit campus, emergency phones
campus_life.nearby_attractions: San Francisco (1 hour), Silicon Valley companies, Pacific Coast beaches, hiking trails

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Active Stanford Korean Alumni Association with Silicon Valley connections
